cards.en: the date or time by which a task must be finished
cards.example: The deadline for the report is Friday.
cards.translation: La fecha límite del informe es el viernes.
cards.prompt: The ___ for the report is Friday.

cards.en: the amount of work a person has to do
cards.example: My workload is heavier this week.
cards.translation: Esta semana tengo más carga de trabajo.
cards.prompt: My ___ is heavier this week.

cards.en: to discuss with someone to reach an agreement
cards.example: We need to negotiate a new delivery date.
cards.translation: Tenemos que negociar una nueva fecha de entrega.
cards.prompt: We need to ___ a new delivery date.

cards.en: information about how well something is working
cards.example: Can you give me feedback on the first draft?
cards.translation: ¿Me puedes dar tu opinión sobre el primer borrador?
cards.prompt: Can you give me ___ on the first draft?

cards.en: something that is more important than other things
cards.example: The client meeting is our priority today.
cards.translation: La reunión con el cliente es nuestra prioridad hoy.
cards.prompt: The client meeting is our ___ today.

cards.en: a further action to check what happened after an earlier one
cards.example: Let us arrange a follow-up call next week.
cards.translation: Organicemos una llamada de seguimiento la semana que viene.
cards.prompt: Let us arrange a ___ call next week.

cards.en: a plan for how much money you will earn and spend
cards.example: We need a monthly budget for food and rent.
cards.translation: Necesitamos un presupuesto mensual para comida y alquiler.
cards.prompt: We need a monthly ___ for food and rent.

cards.en: money that you owe to a person or a bank
cards.example: She is working extra hours to pay off her debt.
cards.translation: Ella hace horas extra para pagar su deuda.
cards.prompt: She is working extra hours to pay off her ___.

cards.en: money that you spend on something
cards.example: Travel is our biggest expense this year.
cards.translation: Los viajes son nuestro mayor gasto este año.
cards.prompt: Travel is our biggest ___ this year.

cards.en: money that you earn from work or from other sources
cards.example: His income is not enough to live in the city.
cards.translation: Sus ingresos no son suficientes para vivir en la ciudad.
cards.prompt: His ___ is not enough to live in the city.

cards.en: an amount of money that a bank lends you and that you must pay back
cards.example: They took a loan to buy a small flat.
cards.translation: Pidieron un préstamo para comprar un piso pequeño.
cards.prompt: They took a ___ to buy a small flat.

cards.en: an agreement to pay a company so that it pays for damage, loss or illness
cards.example: Our car insurance covers accidents.
cards.translation: Nuestro seguro de coche cubre los accidentes.
cards.prompt: Our car ___ covers accidents.

cards.en: to change so that you fit a new situation
cards.example: It took her a month to adapt to the new job.
cards.translation: Tardó un mes en adaptarse al nuevo trabajo.
cards.prompt: It took her a month to ___ to the new job.

cards.en: to make something different, usually a little
cards.example: We had to alter our plans because of the rain.
cards.translation: Tuvimos que cambiar nuestros planes por la lluvia.
cards.prompt: We had to ___ our plans because of the rain.

cards.en: to change something completely
cards.example: The new park will transform the neighbourhood.
cards.translation: El nuevo parque transformará el barrio.
cards.prompt: The new park will ___ the neighbourhood.

cards.en: to start to use a new idea, method or plan
cards.example: The school decided to adopt a new timetable.
cards.translation: El colegio decidió adoptar un nuevo horario.
cards.prompt: The school decided to ___ a new timetable.

cards.en: to change something a little to make it better or more suitable
cards.example: They modified the recipe to make it healthier.
cards.translation: Modificaron la receta para hacerla más sana.
cards.prompt: They ___ the recipe to make it healthier.

cards.en: to become less, or to make something less
cards.example: The number of visitors began to decrease in autumn.
cards.translation: El número de visitantes empezó a disminuir en otoño.
cards.prompt: The number of visitors began to ___ in autumn.

cards.es: pruebas; datos que apoyan que algo es cierto
cards.en: facts or information that give reason to believe something is true
cards.example: The photos provide evidence that the bridge is damaged.
cards.translation: Las fotos aportan pruebas de que el puente está dañado.
cards.prompt: The photos provide ___ that the bridge is damaged.

cards.es: afirmar algo que no se ha demostrado
cards.en: to say something is true although it may not be proved
cards.example: They claim the product works, but they have not shown any proof.
cards.translation: Afirman que el producto funciona, pero no han mostrado ninguna prueba.
cards.prompt: They ___ the product works, but they have not shown any proof.

cards.es: suponer; dar por cierto sin pruebas
cards.en: to accept something as true without proof
cards.example: Do not assume that an email is genuine without checking the sender.
cards.translation: No des por hecho que un correo es auténtico sin comprobar quién lo envía.
cards.prompt: Do not ___ that an email is genuine without checking the sender.

cards.en: to calculate approximately the cost, size or amount of something
cards.example: We estimate that the repairs will cost about €500.
cards.translation: Calculamos que las reparaciones costarán unos 500 €.
cards.prompt: We ___ that the repairs will cost about €500.

cards.en: to judge the quality, value or importance of something
cards.example: The teacher will assess each essay using the same criteria.
cards.translation: El profesor evaluará cada redacción con los mismos criterios.
cards.prompt: The teacher will ___ each essay using the same criteria.

cards.es: justificar; dar una buena razón para algo
cards.en: to give a good reason for an action or decision
cards.example: You must justify the decision by explaining why it was necessary.
cards.translation: Debes justificar la decisión explicando por qué era necesaria.
cards.prompt: You must ___ the decision by explaining why it was necessary.

cards.en: the condition of being extremely poor
cards.example: The government promised to reduce poverty.
cards.translation: El gobierno prometió reducir la pobreza.
cards.prompt: The government promised to reduce ___.

cards.en: actions intended to hurt people or cause damage
cards.example: The report describes years of violence in the region.
cards.translation: El informe describe años de violencia en la región.
cards.prompt: The report describes years of ___ in the region.

cards.en: a person who had to leave their country because of war, politics, religion or poverty
cards.example: Each refugee receives food and a place to sleep.
cards.translation: Cada refugiado recibe comida y un lugar para dormir.
cards.prompt: Each ___ receives food and a place to sleep.

cards.en: a statement that something bad will happen if someone does not do what you want
cards.example: The letter contained a threat against the family.
cards.translation: La carta contenía una amenaza contra la familia.
cards.prompt: The letter contained a ___ against the family.

cards.en: to send out a programme on television or radio
cards.example: They broadcast the news live every evening.
cards.translation: Emiten las noticias en directo cada tarde.
cards.prompt: They ___ the news live every evening.

cards.en: making someone believe something that is not true
cards.example: The advert was misleading, so many people complained.
cards.translation: El anuncio era engañoso, así que mucha gente se quejó.
cards.prompt: The advert was ___, so many people complained.

cards.en: your right to keep your personal matters secret
cards.example: Many people worry about their privacy online.
cards.translation: Mucha gente se preocupa por su privacidad en internet.
cards.prompt: Many people worry about their ___ online.

cards.en: created by computer technology and appearing to exist, but not existing in the physical world
cards.example: The museum offers a virtual tour on its website.
cards.translation: El museo ofrece una visita virtual en su página web.
cards.prompt: The museum offers a ___ tour on its website.

cards.en: made by people, often as a copy of something natural
cards.example: This juice has no artificial colours.
cards.translation: Este zumo no tiene colorantes artificiales.
cards.prompt: This juice has no ___ colours.

cards.en: to make something more modern by adding new information or changing its design
cards.example: You should update the app to fix the problem.
cards.translation: Deberías actualizar la aplicación para arreglar el problema.
cards.prompt: You should ___ the app to fix the problem.

cards.en: a large system of connected parts that allows communication between them
cards.example: The office network is down, so nobody can print.
cards.translation: La red de la oficina está caída, así que nadie puede imprimir.
cards.prompt: The office ___ is down, so nobody can print.

cards.en: the ability to learn, understand and make judgments based on reason
cards.example: Human intelligence is not the same as artificial intelligence.
cards.translation: La inteligencia humana no es lo mismo que la inteligencia artificial.
cards.prompt: Human ___ is not the same as artificial intelligence.

cards.en: a set of ideas or a plan of what to do in particular situations, agreed officially by a government or organization
cards.example: The government changed its policy on housing.
cards.translation: El Gobierno cambió su política de vivienda.
cards.prompt: The government changed its ___ on housing.

cards.en: the group of elected politicians who make the laws in some countries
cards.example: The new law was discussed in parliament.
cards.translation: La nueva ley se debatió en el parlamento.
cards.prompt: The new law was discussed in ___.

cards.en: a member of the government who is in charge of a particular department
cards.example: The minister answered questions about the health system.
cards.translation: La ministra respondió a preguntas sobre el sistema sanitario.
cards.prompt: The ___ answered questions about the health system.

cards.en: a serious discussion of a subject in which many people take part
cards.example: There was a long debate about the new tax.
cards.translation: Hubo un largo debate sobre el nuevo impuesto.
cards.prompt: There was a long ___ about the new tax.

cards.en: a system of government in which power is held by freely elected representatives
cards.example: Voting is an important part of democracy.
cards.translation: Votar es una parte importante de la democracia.
cards.prompt: Voting is an important part of ___.

cards.en: a person who is competing to get a job or an elected position
cards.example: Each candidate explained their plans for the city.
cards.translation: Cada candidato explicó sus planes para la ciudad.
cards.prompt: Each ___ explained their plans for the city.
